positive: An interface needs a spacing scale, content-derived rhythm, or gap consistency
A page feels mechanically even or inconsistently spaced
negative: The request is only responsive reflow or component state behavior
The request is to choose type or color

exclusions: Do not impose one uniform cadence across dissimilar content
Do not leave off-scale spacing values without an evidence-backed exception

outputs.primary: A tokenized spacing scale and stated section-rhythm strategy tied to content hierarchy

stop_conditions: Pause when content hierarchy is absent and spacing would be arbitrary
Do not declare completion without checking off-scale values
